sources.title: qwen3-vl-flash model information
sources.evidence: Rechecked October 27: indexed official card describes a small-scale visual model outperforming Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, and explicitly maps the alias to qwen3-vl-flash-2026-01-22. Neither the alias nor snapshot description states total or active parameters, or identifies a named size-bearing base model. The 30B-A3B statement is a performance comparison. Direct opening again exceeded the reader content-size limit; indexed text was read.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Live lifecycle table lists qwen3-vl-flash and its 2025-10-15 snapshot as released in Beijing on 2025-10-14, then internationally on 2025-10-15. The row describes visual reasoning, image/video understanding and long documents.

sources.title: qwen3-vl-flash regional capabilities
sources.evidence: Indexed exact-model card shows regional capability tables: Beijing supports Function Calling; Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia show it unsupported. The January 2026 snapshot table also marks it unsupported. Direct opening exceeded the browser tool's content-size limit.

sources.title: Update Notice for Qwen3-VL-Flash Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the March 19, 2026 notice maps the Beijing/Singapore alias from qwen3-vl-flash-2025-10-15 to qwen3-vl-flash-2026-01-22, effective March 24. This establishes snapshot lineage, but neither snapshot has a parameter count in the notice.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL official repository
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: official repository enumerates the open Qwen3-VL sizes and dense/MoE configurations, without identifying Flash as a variant of a named open model. Family architecture and open-model counts therefore do not establish Flash specifications; the repository license remains inapplicable to this hosted alias.

sources.title: Function Calling
sources.evidence: Supported-model list includes Qwen3-VL-Flash series separately from the Qwen3-VL open-source series. Supports tool capability at family level but does not override regional model-card restrictions.

sources.title: Building AI Products with Qwen
sources.evidence: Indexed official API landing page names Qwen3-VL-Flash and text/image/video inputs with text output, but lists 131027 context length. This conflicts with the exact Alibaba Cloud Model Studio card's 262144; the service-specific card is used for this Alibaba Cloud record.

sources.title: Models.dev original qwen3-vl-flash record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source was inspected as a lead. It records October 15 and open_weights=false; it does not independently establish weights availability or first regional release.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh review of the architecture section and comparison tables: the report names dense 2B/4B/8B/32B and MoE 30B-A3B/235B-A22B variants and publishes activated counts for named MoE models. It does not identify Qwen3-VL-Flash with any of those variants or give a Flash total/active count. Published open-model nominal counts remain valid for those named models, but provide no Flash lineage inference.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B official model card and later comparison tables
sources.evidence: Later first-party card explicitly links Qwen3.5-Flash to 35B-A3B and gives 35B total/3B activated language-model parameters. Its comparison table names Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, not Qwen3-VL-Flash. This is an explicit mapping for a different Flash model, not evidence of lineage or counts for this entry. No activated-parameter table entry for Qwen3-VL-Flash was found.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B official model card and later vision-language table
sources.evidence: Later first-party vision-language comparison table names Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B as a baseline. Neither Qwen3-VL-Flash nor an activated-parameter entry for it appears. Direct raw README checks corroborated the rendered table; no weight files were downloaded.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL-Flash on the Qianwen AI platform
sources.evidence: Fresh indexed official platform card repeats the performance comparison with Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, without a total/active count or named-base relationship. Direct opening returned 404, so this evidence is limited to indexed text. English and Chinese searches for parameter counts, activated parameters, base-model relationships and fine-tuning found no additional first-party Flash disclosure.

name.note: Readable display name for the exact qwen3-vl-flash hosted identifier.

release_date.note: Earliest documented availability is Beijing on October 14; October 15 is the international/global launch and original snapshot suffix.

open_weights.note: Primary materials document a hosted alias distinct from the open-source checkpoints, with no Flash weight download. They do not explicitly establish non-release. No verified exact weight release or explicit closed-weight statement; clear the unsupported baseline boolean.

license.note: No exact-model weight license is stated; the open repository's Apache-2.0 license is not evidence for Flash.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source review found no nominal total or explicit relationship to a size-bearing base. The documented lineage is to a Flash snapshot whose size is also undisclosed; outperforming 30B-A3B does not identify the base.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count found in the Flash card, Qwen3-VL report or later first-party comparison tables. The 3B figure belongs to named open models or Qwen3.5-Flash and cannot be assigned to Qwen3-VL-Flash.

architecture.note: No exact hosted-model topology disclosed; dense versus MoE remains unknown.

context_window.note: Exact Model Studio limit; conflicting Qwen API landing-page value is recorded in s7.

reasoning.note: Thinking mode is explicitly supported alongside non-thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Verified for Beijing only. Regional card says unsupported in Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia; this boolean must not imply universal deployment support.

description.value: Alibaba Cloud hosted Qwen3-VL model for image, video and document understanding, with optional thinking mode.
description.note: Replaces broad agent-task phrasing with directly documented capabilities.

patch.description: Alibaba Cloud hosted Qwen3-VL model for image, video and document understanding, with optional thinking mode.
patch.notes: Hosted rolling alias; total and active parameter counts and dense/MoE architecture remain undisclosed. The official card compares performance with Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B without identifying it as the base. Function calling is documented for Beijing but unsupported in Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia. Beijing availability began 2025-10-14; international/global availability began 2025-10-15. The documented alias maps to the 2026-01-22 snapshot. Model-card specifications were read through the search index; current endpoint availability was not tested.

sources.label: Qwen3.5 later comparison and distinct Flash mapping

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit nulls for total and active parameters. Official Flash cards disclose snapshot lineage and performance superiority to 30B-A3B, but no size-bearing base relationship; the Qwen3-VL technical report and later Qwen3.5 comparison tables do not supply Flash counts. The separate Qwen3.5-Flash mapping cannot be transferred. Prior release, modality, reasoning, context, regional tool and weight-status assessments are preserved.
